title: Pre-anesthesia Assessment Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Assess airway risk, cardiopulmonary status, allergy history, and prior anesthetic complications before finalizing the anesthetic plan.
Escalate preoperative review when unstable comorbidity, difficult airway risk, or inadequate optimization is present.
Document fasting status, consent, and medication holds explicitly before surgery.

title: Postoperative Pain Management Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use multimodal analgesia and procedure-specific planning rather than opioid-only postoperative management.
Escalate when pain is disproportionate, neurologic deficits emerge, or respiratory depression risk is high.
Reassess pain control after intervention rather than assuming one-time dosing is adequate.

title: PONV Prophylaxis Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Match prophylaxis intensity to baseline PONV risk and planned anesthetic exposure.
Use multimodal antiemetic prophylaxis for higher-risk patients rather than rescue-only strategies.
Review prior PONV history and opioid exposure when selecting prophylaxis.
